newsitem.title: DUBAI: First cells of Dubai Aluminium expansion start up.
newsitem.headline: First cells of Dubai Aluminium expansion start up.

text.p: Dubai Aluminium Co Ltd(Dubal) said on Sunday it had started up the first two production cells of its newly expanded capacity ahead of schedule and below budget.

"Dubai Aluminium Company's $500 million expansion programme, The Falcon Project, has exceeded all expectations in achieving the start up of the first production cells ahead of schedule and well under budget," it said in a statement.
The first two cells of the new project to expand annual capacity by over 50 percent to 375,000 tonnes were energised on Saturday, it said.
Another 58 new cells are ready for start up, with the remaining 180 cells of the new 240 unit potline still being prepared for start up by March 1997.
Last October Dubal chief executive Ian Rugeroni said the project was running $50 million below budget and four months ahead of schedule.

The cost of the government-owned smelter's expansion was initially put at $503 million, half of which was raised through a syndicated loan arranged and underwritten by Merrill Lynch and co-managed by Emirates Bank International and the National Bank of Dubai. Dubal self-financed the other half.
